title: Retaliation Begin Cleanup
acceptance: If RetaliationService.begin errors after marking some monsters as pursuing, every monster it marked is released (pursuing cleared, Inspect enabled) and no pursuit record is left half-built.
The error still reaches CaptureService.onFled's pcall: it is warned, and the target falls back to the slipped-away removal.
The Retaliation scenario injects a failure inside begin after the first pursuer is set and checks that no monster is left pursuing and the target was removed.
Normal pursuits are unchanged: Retaliation, FullLoop and ExploitProbe pass; scripts/check.sh passes.
